body:
**Description**

A proof-of-concept implementation of https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/627 allowing validator clients to supply a selected execution payload bid. Relates to the Beacon API tracking issue #9045 .

- Adds `POST /eth/v4/validator/blocks/{slot}/with_bid`
- Reuses the existing V4 block-production pipeline, payload caching, and JSON/SSZ response handling.
- Validate the supplied bid, apply the requested boost factor, and fall back to local production when the bid is invalid or the circuit breaker is active.

**Validation:**

- 34 targeted tests pass, covering bid selection, validation, fallback, JSON/SSZ handling, and request errors.
- `cargo check -p http_api` and formatting checks pass.
- Manually tested on a local Kurtosis devnet.

**AI Assistance Disclosure**

This PR’s implementation and tests were written primarily by OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Astra High), with human review and direction.
title: Add `produceBlockV4WithBid` Beacon API endpoint
